name: Level streaming
body: Dean (2026-11-20): engine level work. Rooms of a big level load and unload by how near the player and the partner are, so a bigger level costs about what the part you are standing in costs: fewer live entities, fewer lights, a smaller collision world and no hitch when a room appears. The partner's routes and the lights must stay right across a room boundary. The game never reads Calamus files: rooms are authored in the world file, which the build already bakes. Design in docs/level-streaming.md, decisions D-226 onwards. Dean (2026-11-20, later): composed scene objects: a scene is an object holding objects, placed and stitched into the world, with a low-LOD peek into the neighbouring scene through the opening. Built on rooms: a placed scene is a room.
